_comment: Torchlight design tokens. Single source of truth for color. Every downstream consumer (CSS custom properties, Shiki code theme, Mermaid theme, OG image generator) reads from this file and never hardcodes a hex value. Type scale, spacing, ornament, and component rules live in design.md.
name: Torchlight
_states: Two worlds. 'hollowed' is Lordran: muted brown and ash, one light source above the content, haze at three depths, film grain, and gold as RARE relief. 'kindled' is Anor Londo: the same architecture under sunlight. Neither is derived from the other. Host mapping: hollowed answers to data-theme='dark', kindled to data-theme='light'.

hollowed._source: Built on the Dark Souls Remastered ramp #1b1a17 / #38322b / #695442 / #a78a6d / #f4efde — warm desaturated sepia, not cold ash. The desaturation signals decay; the hue underneath stays warm. Gold is the series' UI biscuit tone. NOTE: --ground sits BELOW the ramp's darkest step, at #100f0d rather than #1b1a17. The ramp still governs the hue; the ground was dropped a step in August 2026 because the extra point of contrast it buys every ink level is what makes the page read.

roles.--ground: page background. Warm sepia when hollowed, white when kindled. Hollowed is never flat black — the glow and vignette layers are part of the ground, not decoration on it
roles.--border: structural divides; section rules, table borders, carved frames. Kept low-contrast against the ground on purpose — a hard hairline reads as harshly as glaring text
roles.--text: primary reading text. Deliberately held near 9:1 hollowed and 12:1 kindled rather than pushed to maximum — text should sit into the page, not float on top of it
roles.--text-4: disabled state, rune bullets, decorative only (fails AA for body copy)
roles.--torch: THE accent. Biscuit gold when hollowed, gold leaf when kindled. Links, active state, focus. Budget: max 8% of viewport area
roles.--torch-tint: solid badge/tag background behind torch-colored text. Solid hex, never rgba()
roles.--arcane: the magic register: code, diagrams, footnotes, asides. Dulled teal when hollowed (dead magic), lapis ultramarine when kindled (divine). Never used for a job --torch already does
roles.--blood: semantic only: danger, removed, deprecated, breaking. Never decorative
roles.--ornament: the ornament channel. Equals --torch when kindled and --text-4 when hollowed, so ornament goes out with the world. Never read --torch directly for a mark.
roles.--vignette: edge falloff paired with --glow so light gathers at the centre and drains at the borders. Hollowed it drains to black; kindled it settles toward parchment
roles.--panel: the recessed surface behind code blocks and diagrams — a darker patch of the same room, not a floating menu. Ash carries no frames, blur or drop shadow, so this is the only surface tone the theme has. Hollowed it is translucent black over the lit ground; kindled it is warm off-white, held far enough off pure white to read as a block
roles.--haze: atmospheric fill between the light source and the vignette. Layered at three depths so the dark has volume instead of being a flat fill
roles.--grain: opacity of the film-grain layer, which sits BEHIND the content. Over the top it renders every glyph through noise and the page looks dirty rather than atmospheric. Kept low: grain is meant to be felt, not seen.
roles.--shaft: the single light source, entering from above the content. Narrow, so most of the page is not lit by it
roles.--scene-ink: the ink the per-page scene vignette is drawn in. It contrasts AWAY from the ground in both worlds — a lit mass emerging from the dark when hollowed, a sepia wash on paper when kindled. Never a black silhouette: the hollowed ground is already near-black and a dark scene would simply vanish into it
roles.--scene-opacity: how far the scene sits back behind the text. Low enough that a paragraph over it stays readable, high enough that the shape reads at 220px
roles.--blood-tint: solid background behind --blood text in a danger callout. Solid hex, never rgba()

syntax._comment: Shiki code theme. Three hues plus two neutrals — every color is a symbol, so an unused color is a lie. Anything not listed renders as plain.

diagram._comment: Mermaid theme role mapping. Diagrams sit in the arcane register, so the accent role takes --arcane, not --torch.
